prompt: I need to move data from Go.Data to CommCare: pull the newest user, set its bruteForceLoginDate to today's date, and post it to CommCare as a web user.
workflow_yaml:
name: dry-run
jobs:
  fetch:
    name: Fetch record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-http@latest'
    body: |
      get('/api/users', { query: { filter: JSON.stringify({ order: 'createdAt DESC', limit: 1 }) } });
  post:
    name: Post record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-commcare@latest'
    body: |
      fn(state => {
        const u = state.data[0];
        state.webUser = { email: u.email, first_name: u.firstName, last_name: u.lastName, role: 'App User', bruteForceLoginDate: new Date().toISOString() };
        return state;
      });
      post('/web-user', state => state.webUser);
triggers:
  webhook:
    type: webhook
edges:
  webhook->fetch:
    source_trigger: webhook
    target_job: fetch
  fetch->post:
    source_job: fetch
    target_job: post
    condition_type: on_job_success
